description: This file is a Java source file configuring Spring Security for a web application. It defines security settings such as permitting all requests, disabling CSRF for development, setting headers for H2 console, and ignoring static and API documentation endpoints.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Spring Security settings, enabling web security, and defining beans to configure security filter chain and request ignoring rules.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines the main security filter chain configuration, allowing all requests, disabling CSRF and login mechanisms, and setting headers for H2 console.

methods.name: webSecurityCustomizer
methods.description: Configures Spring Security to ignore static resources, API documentation, and H2 console paths for performance and usability.
